# Mayten Lane

> Go-to-market sprint studio for growing technology companies. Created and operated in Berkeley, California, by Alexander Tibbets and Janicke Rich. We work with startups on product marketing, positioning, AI GTM workflows, and executive coaching.

## Core offerings

- **Product Marketing & Positioning**: Sharp product narratives, launch sprints, and go-to-market strategy for early-stage AI, developer tool, and B2B SaaS startups.
- **Custom AI GTM Workflows**: Building and handing off custom AI systems for product launches, CRM and lead enrichment, customer research, demand generation, and growth loops.
- **Executive Coaching & Leadership**: Coaching founders and startup executives through rapid scale, organizational alignment, and leadership transitions.
- **Community & Customer Lifecycle**: Building developer ecosystems, user communities, and onboarding and retention engines.

## Leadership

- [Alexander Tibbets](https://www.alexandertibbets.com): Co-founder of IFTTT and 3x AI startup marketing leader (Imbue, Bito AI, Parabola). Leads product marketing, positioning, and custom AI GTM workflows.
- [Janicke Rich](https://www.janickerich.com): Executive coach and operations leader. Leads founder and executive coaching, leadership development, and organizational alignment.

## Target market

- **Stage**: Startups (Seed to Series B)
- **Domains**: AI startups, developer tools, B2B SaaS, and developer platforms
- **Geography**: San Francisco Bay Area (Berkeley and San Francisco) and major technology hubs
